purpose: Offline calibration material for synthetic teaching scenarios; not a forecast and not a public site data source.

provider.name: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
provider.verificationBasis: reference/forecast-model-feeds.md and the archived wrfprs-derived profile named below

method: Copied run, site, valid-time, surface, and pressure-level values from the archived published profile.
Reconstructed every surface and pressure-level dewPointDepressionC as temperatureC minus dewPointC, rounded to 0.01 C because the archived inputs were already rounded to 0.01 C.

Renamed published precipitationMmHr to the derivation input precipitationMm; for this HRRR builder the source is instantaneous PRATE multiplied by 3600 and the published contract exposes that one-hour-equivalent rate.
Copied all archived optional surface capability inputs without substitution or imputation.
Removed every derived block. No derived quantity is authored by this baseline.

Removed the archived site.altitudeM (2026-08-10, launch decoupling): derivation inputs are launch-agnostic, and the launch a scenario teaches against lives in its definition's launch block. The captured value survives as site.launchAltitudeM above and in the archived profile.
omittedFields: levels[].verticalVelocityPaS (not retained by the archived fixture, so it cannot be reconstructed honestly)
levels[].cloudFractionPercent (HRRR wrfprs does not publish per-pressure-level cloud fraction)

reconstructedDewPointC.reason: Temperature and dew point in the archived fixture are rounded to 0.01 C.

derivedCloudBaseM.reason: The archived profile used the earlier 121 m/C cloud-base approximation; the current authority uses the Bolton LCL calculation.

derivedUsableLiftTopM.reason: Usable lift is cloud-limited in one archived hour and inherits the documented cloud-base method change.
